I am applying for the Frontend Developer role. At Atlas Pixel Studio, I spent 1.5 years building React and TypeScript dashboards for six client projects from Figma designs to production.

My daily work matches your core needs. I built responsive, accessible pages that pass WCAG 2.1 AA checks with axe, and connected front ends to client REST APIs using fetch and React Query. I also wrote unit tests with Vitest and React Testing Library.

I am eager to learn GraphQL and end-to-end testing with Playwright or Cypress on your team. I would love to talk about how I can contribute to your scheduling tools.

Salma Haddad

drafts.coverLetter:
Hello,

I am writing to apply for the Embedded Firmware Engineer role at Vaultic Devices. As a recent Computer Science graduate with hands-on experience in Python through projects like JobFeed API, I am eager to transition my skills into building low-power sensors for pharmaceutical cold-chain monitoring.

My academic background in computer science and project work in Python give me a strong foundation for test automation and backend development. While my experience has been primarily in web technologies and Python APIs, I am very keen to learn low-power design, RTOS, and ARM Cortex-M firmware development to support your hardware teams in Lisbon.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my programming background can contribute to Vaultic Devices. Thank you for your time.

Nour El Idrissi
